scope: Offline captured canonical walls plus explicitly synthetic tail/revision exercise inputs on actual Pi; five alternating synchronous Canvas draw CPU samples per variant/market/stage. Compiler runs in a child that exits before Chromium. Gzipped financial input is read by Chromium directly rather than serialized through CDP; driver-only GC (when exposed) runs outside the measurements, never browser GC. Added renderer-only tail and correction inputs are not venue observations. Geometry is compared directly without copying it into diagnostic arrays. Internal paintOrder ordinal is excluded from geometry comparison; all incumbent drawable fields remain exact. Actual OpenAlgo DataLayer over an explicit UTC axis fixture (OHLC1 is not financial source). Original financial input hashes/geometry fields and every readback pixel must match; coordinate-only roundoff <=1e-8 CSS pixels is recorded, not applied to runtime data. Readback/hashing excluded from draw timing. Includes current append, close/reopen, correction/removal, reference/style/view invalidation and mixed Threshold fallback. Closed path counts and style visits are recorded; no whole-app heap plateau is inferred. Canvas2D willReadFrequently=true hint; no raster backend inference. Not app/live-route/current-concurrency, GPU completion, FPS, cold build or foreground acceptance.
